vo: For decades, China was the most populous nation on Earth, untouchable. But India was rising fast. Year after year the gap shrank, until, in twenty twenty-three, India quietly overtook China to become the most populous country in human history. Meanwhile Nigeria and Pakistan surge up the ranks. By twenty twenty-six, the map of humanity looks nothing like before. Follow, for the numbers nobody explains.
